programs.title: Matched case-control command tour
programs.description: Profiles completeness and descriptive statistics, reproduces the guide's AnyChkn matched-pair question, and demonstrates conditional logistic adjustment for age.
programs.source:
EPIAI QUALITY *

LIST uid matched_pairs caco age anychkn

FREQ caco

FREQ matched_pairs

FREQ anychkn

MEANS age

TABLES anychkn caco

MATCH anychkn caco MATCHVAR=matched_pairs

LOGISTIC caco = anychkn age MATCHVAR=matched_pairs TITLETEXT="Illustrative chicken exposure model adjusted for age"

programs.title: PB matched-pair analysis
programs.description: Runs only the bounded 1:1 MATCH candidate so its paired counts and exclusions can be reviewed directly.

programs.title: School exposure zero-cell boundary
programs.description: Runs FREQ, TABLES, and MATCH where one discordant direction is zero, producing a positive-infinity matched odds ratio with an explicit boundary state.
programs.source:
FREQ school

TABLES school caco

MATCH school caco MATCHVAR=matched_pairs
